comparison_evidence: Actual light cards and recent thumbnail sheet inspected. Sewaddle has round cheeks and twin buns, Throh short red-black hair and a sharper mouth, Sawk a narrow blue-haired face, Seismitoad blue curled hair. Swadloon has a single olive bun and an oval face with long brows.
diversity_comparison: The studio detective is seated on a dark cushion with a prop magnifier and coat/dress; the satin fitting leans at a dressing table with one hand on hip; the silk lounge set sits in an outdoor hammock holding a map. Actual results differ in place, hand activity, garment silhouette and framing. Sewaddle’s punk back view, full-body tidal-pool swimsuit and long conservatory gown differ from all three. Recent Throh/Sawk/Seismitoad thumbnails were also inspected.
